headline: Weathered Expanse Grinds On; Fisherman's Row Stirs Again
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has not slackened since the previous edition: nine events in the last six hours about Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk, Wardens holding six squares to three Colonial, and the day's heaviest returns, some 8,525 Colonial and 13,782 Warden casualties in twenty-four hours. Fisherman's Row, silent three hours ago, has reopened at Eidolo and Black Well with three events in the last two hours, its colours now two Warden, six Colonial and one neutral. Callahan's Passage keeps grinding at The Crumbling Passage and Scáth Passing, six events in six hours, Wardens on eight squares of ten. Stlican Shelf reports six events in the same window at Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, its line split four Warden to five Colonial. Mooring County remains busy about The Wind Hills, Wiccwalk and The Cut, ten squares Warden to two Colonial, casualties there running high. Palantine Berm, quiet at the last report, has logged five events in six hours at Leiri Hermanni. Nevish Line and Stema Landing have gone still, and Colonials retain sole colours over the great majority of regions.
